body:
Pretty much self explanatory, some maps rots have like 80 players on their maximum, when it's not meant for that, wich makes gameplay suck and avicus can't handle that amount of people in one server, so it starts to lag, btw, we also have 4/6 servers empty everytime, so why not to distribute the people better, so we can have all the servers active and enjoy the game.I'm not asking for a huge change, just 10/20.
+1 or -1?
